title: mtf-facts affected
description: The examples a change can affect, most likely first: touched, then caller, then every other example with reason all. With a fallback every example has reason all and inert is false. With module_root, every path is repository-relative and the examples are the module root's own and the repository-root examples that call it.

module_root.description: Present only with --module-root: the repository-relative directory of the module under review.

inert.description: True only when every changed path is a documentation or metadata path no HCL read site reaches.

unresolved.description: Present only with module_root: a repository-root example listed with reason all because the engine could not tell whether it calls the module root.
